stages.title: Field Assignment
body: Good. The road is not safe unless you can hold your own.
Go east and defeat the Field Wasp by the lanterns. Bring back proof.
stages.footer: Objective accepted: kill 1 Field Wasp and return.
stages.object_chat: Go east and defeat the Field Wasp.

stages.title: Current Objective
body: The wasp is still alive. Stay in melee range before attacking.
stages.footer: Return after you obtain the Wasp Stinger.
stages.object_chat: Bring me the Wasp Stinger when the field is clear.

stages.title: Training Cleared
body: You handled the field assignment cleanly.
Take this Guide Ring and repair powder. Keep your bag organized.
stages.footer: Reward delivered: 300 gold, Guide Ring, Repair Powder x2.
stages.object_chat: Well done. Take your reward and prepare for the next road.

stages.title: After Action
body: Your starter reward is already issued.
Use the bag, belt, and character panes to inspect the live state.
stages.footer: More quest branches will be layered on top of this state model.
stages.object_chat: Training is complete. Review your gear before moving on.

stages.title: Newbie Trainer
body: Welcome, recruit. I run the training regimen for this province.
Each lesson you complete sharpens you and raises your level.
Come back after every lesson — the next one opens as you grow.
stages.footer: Take the lesson to gain training experience.
stages.object_chat: Step up, recruit — let's run a lesson.

stages.title: Mid-Lesson
body: Focus — we finish what we start.
stages.footer: Finish the drill to earn your experience.

stages.title: Lesson Cleared
body: Good work. That experience is yours.
Train, grow, and the road to level 30 will open before you.

stages.title: Between Lessons
body: Grow a little more and the next lesson will be ready for you.
stages.footer: Return at a higher level for the next lesson.
stages.object_chat: Come back when you're a touch stronger.
